content.value:
# Jumper Rules

Players move through a side-scrolling platform level, cross pits, stack on each other when needed, and try to reach the flag. Reaching the flag scores one point and respawns the player at the start. Falling below the level respawns the player. The player with the most flag captures when time runs out wins.

# Play Jumper

Connect with the sprite protocol player websocket, move right through the level, jump over gaps and walls, and cooperate with other players to cross larger hazards. The bundled dalli player is a deterministic flag-seeking baseline bot.
